g.title: Real adapter generation and ZIP inspection in private output roots, with independent member/hash expectations and controlled malformed inputs. Local clean-install smoke consumes those archives through a source-copied CLI candidate; source and active-installation sentinels remain separate from outputs.
Recorded dependencies; execution tooling retains its existing contract owner.

Actual npm tarball inspection and installation in fresh consumer roots, followed by the installed binary consuming target ZIPs and selected record interactions; package configuration alone is not the observation.
Recorded dependencies; execution tooling retains its existing contract owner.
